tasks.label: Initialize Git Submodules & LFS
tasks.command: powershell

tasks.label: Start LightRAG Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/LightRAG && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/lightRAG -- uv run lightrag-server

tasks.label: Start Knowledge Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/knowledge && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/knowledge -- uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tasks.label: Start Wayfinder Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/wayfinder && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/wayfinder -- uv run uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8004

tasks.label: Start Piper TTS Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/voice/piper_tts && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/voice -- uv run uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000

tasks.label: Pull LFS Files for Voice
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/voice && git lfs pull

tasks.label: Start Voice Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/voice && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/voice -- uv run python server.py

tasks.label: Start API Gateway Auth Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/api_gateway && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/api_gateway -- uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8008

tasks.label: Start Dashboard Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/dashboard && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/dashboard -- uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8007

tasks.label: Start Agent Service (Backend)
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/agent-service-toolkit && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/agent -- uv run python src/run_service.py

tasks.label: Start Frontend
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/frontend && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/frontend -- npm run dev

tasks.label: Start API Gateway (Docker)
tasks.command: npx @infisical/cli run --path=/api_gateway -- docker-compose up -d

tasks.label: Start Dashboard Infrastructure (Docker)
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/dashboard/docker && npx @infisical/cli run --path=/dashboard -- docker compose up -d

tasks.label: Migrate Knowledge Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/knowledge && uv run alembic upgrade head

tasks.label: Migrate Dashboard Service
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/dashboard && uv run alembic upgrade head

tasks.label: Install LightRAG Requirements
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/LightRAG" -Mode "editable"

tasks.label: Install Knowledge Requirements
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/knowledge" -Mode "pip"

tasks.label: Install Wayfinder Requirements
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/wayfinder" -Mode "pip"

tasks.label: Install Voice Requirements
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/voice" -Mode "pip"

tasks.label: Sync API Gateway Dependencies
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/api_gateway" -Mode "sync"

tasks.label: Sync Dashboard Dependencies
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/dashboard" -Mode "sync"

tasks.label: Sync Agent Service Dependencies
tasks.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ${workspaceFolder}/install-dependencies.ps1 -ServicePath "${workspaceFolder}/agent-service-toolkit" -Mode "sync"

tasks.label: Install Frontend Dependencies
tasks.command: cd /d ${workspaceFolder}/frontend && npm install

tasks.label: Check Infisical
tasks.command: npx @infisical/cli --version

tasks.command: docker stop $(docker ps -q) 2>nul || echo No containers running

tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM python.exe /T 2>nul || echo No python processes
